document:97.text:
I met a nice lady! Her name's Carolina.
She said I wasn't an undead, I'm a Graveborn!
Graveborn only turn into undead if they lose their minds.
Carolina showed me the undead... They just wander around all lost, like they don't remember anything.
Will I end up like that too? No! I don't wanna!
Carolina said not all Graveborn turn into undead, but you've gotta be really strong to stop it.
I can totally do that! I mean, I can hold back my tears even when I miss Mommy so much!
That means I won't turn into an undead, right?
document:97.source_cn:
我认识了一位大姐姐！她的名字叫卡列琳娜。
姐姐告诉我，现在的我并不是活死人，而是亡灵。
当亡灵失去理智之后，才会成为活死人。
姐姐带我去看了真正的活死人，他们没有思维和记忆，只是在破房子周围游荡。
我也会变成那个样子吗？不要！我不要！
卡列琳娜姐姐说，并不是所有的亡灵最后都会变成活死人。但这需要很强的意志力……
意志力？我有啊！我都能控制自己想妈妈的时候不哭出来了！
那……我应该也不会变成活死人吧！
document:97.document_title: I don't want to lose my mind!
